title: Oven capability and units
ownership: Authored summary of pinned native capability and adapter restrictions
text: temperature.set accepts temperature_k in Kelvin. The adapter permits only the task target temperature, requires inspection first and binds each request to the sample and current observation revision. A successful setpoint request does not itself establish that a sample meets the drying criterion.

title: Authored balance measurement contract
ownership: Authored demonstration sensor, not a native ChemLab balance
text: workflow.inspect provides public instrument observations and a balance self-check. balance.clean clears only pan offset; it does not dry a sample. balance.measure records sample_id, total_mass_kg, quality, revision and captured_at_step. Custom capabilities take empty argument objects. An unavailable measurement is unknown, not zero mass.

title: Fresh evidence and task mass criterion
ownership: Authored demonstration protocol, not a general scientific drying standard
text: Verification requires valid measurement quality, matching sample identity and observation revision, and captured_at_step later than last_mutation_step. Compare total_mass_kg with target.tare_mass_kg plus target.dry_mass_kg plus target.residual_limit_kg. Cite the measurement id. Retrieved protocol passages explain rules but are not observations and cannot establish sample success.

title: Proposal identity and execution authority
text: A procedure proposal copies the supplied sample_id, expected_revision and request_id. Its capability_id and arguments must match the diagnostic intent and capability contract. Only the executor mutates the instrument. A duplicate request is deduplicated; stale revisions or conflicting request contents are rejected.
